business_scope.primary_industry_name: Laser Micro-Machining of Bioresorbable Vascular Polymer Stents

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code; unitary state with codified commercial law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Franco-Chinese Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (2007, entered into force 2010)
France-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (signed 2013, generally applied from 2015)
France-Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (entered into force 1997)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 to L.561-57 and R.561-1 to R.561-60 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier); French Décret n°2018-284 implementing AMLD4/AMLD5; Arrêté of 1 September 2020; Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843; EU Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on wire transfers; relevant provisions of French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) on beneficial ownership declarations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card for each UBO and gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport/identity-issuing authority of the individual's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization (for non-Hague countries) plus sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / registration extract of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / statutes of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate shareholder's registered office / notary / registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address for each UBO and gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or local government authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy; Hague Apostille or consular legalization if required by the target registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized and apostilled if required; original letter from the bank where possible

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney for the incorporation agent or local statutory representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: All shareholders / UBOs executing before their local notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Hague Apostille or consular legalization + sworn French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, gérants, and authorized signatories against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UN Security Council consolidated list, French national asset-freezing orders (arrêtés of the Ministry of Economy), OFAC SDN List (best practice for USD clearing), and FATF-public high-risk third-country lists. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons (PEPs), family members, and close associates under Article L.561-10 of the French Monetary and Financial Code. Any beneficial owner at or above 25% must provide KYC evidence, including identity, residential address, source of funds, and a police/court certificate or equivalent. Suspicious transaction or activity reports are obligatory to TRACFIN under Article L.561-15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); company registration data accessible via Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutes and constitutive documents must be in French. The corporate name may be in any language, but it must be expressed in Latin alphabet characters; if a non-Latin-script name is used, a Latin-script transliteration must appear in the articles of association. The name must not be deceptive, contrary to public order, or imply a regulated activity without the appropriate license. The legal form suffix 'SARL' must be stated in all public and internal documents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not provide a formal statutory name-reservation procedure; the 30-day validity reflects the effective reliance period for a preliminary INPI trademark pre-check and RCS availability search. If the RCS/greffe rejects the incorporation filing because the proposed name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing name, the applicant may: (i) modify the name and re-file through the Guichet Unique; or (ii) file an administrative appeal before the President of the competent Tribunal judiciaire within two months of the rejection notice, attaching proof of prior rights or distinctiveness. Urgent relief may be sought by référé proceedings. A trademark opposition may also be filed before INPI under the French Intellectual Property Code.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not permissible as the sole registered seat for a Class III medical device manufacturer. A physical registered office in France is mandatory, plus an operational facility registered with the relevant authorities. A professional domiciliation address (domiciliation) may be used only for correspondence and legal seat purposes, provided the actual drug-eluting stent manufacturing, quality control, warehousing, and EU MDR/ANSM-required technical operations are located at a separate physical French establishment with a notarized lease or title.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – estimated >75% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months, due to ANSM/EU MDR post-market surveillance under Regulation (EU) 2017/745, and to standard French tax/AML physical control checks for high-risk companies in the medical device sector.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name pre-search and trademark availability check (INPI + RCS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory trademark search fee (approx. EUR 35-45) plus prevailing market search rate.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet unique incorporation and RCS registration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (filed via INPI Guichet Unique)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal announcement in a legal gazette (annonce légale)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Legal announcements newspaper (JAL) in the selected département
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per line for publication of the incorporation notice in a departmental authorized legal journal.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign document notarization and apostille bundle (five documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local notaries and apostille authorities in the documents' countries of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market notarial fee plus fixed official apostille fees (approx. EUR 50-150 per document).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation of foreign public and corporate documents into French
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator registered with the Cour d'appel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (approx. EUR 90-120 per standard page).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration filing and AML/KYC enhanced due diligence (all UBOs and gérants)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm / external AML compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee for enhanced due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, and UBO register drafting.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Power of attorney notarization for incorporation agent (executed in France, if applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fee per French notarial tariff.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq.; implementing procedures under Order No. 2021-1189 and the PACTE Act; EU MDR 2017/745 for consequential medical-device facility obligations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce in the territorial jurisdiction of the registered office, acting on behalf of the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statutory incorporation file comprising the executed Statuts and the M0 constitution form transmitted via the Guichet Unique de formalités des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for a SARL; the articles may fix capital at €1. If cash capital is established above €1, at least 20% of cash contributions (apports en numéraire) must be paid up before registration, and the balance must be paid within five years. Cash contributions must be placed in escrow with a French bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and released only after the company obtains its Kbis extract. In-kind contributions must be fully paid up at formation and, if material, verified by a statutory contributions auditor (commissaire aux apports).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The duly convened shareholders of the SARL adopt their first resolution and unanimously resolve that: (1) the subscription of the full share capital by the founders, as set out in the share subscription table, is approved and the blocked-funds certificate of the depositary is acknowledged; (2) the registered office is established at [street address, postal code, city], within the jurisdiction of the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, and the manager is instructed to register such office in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés; (3) [full name] is appointed as sole gérant for an indefinite term, with power to bind the company in all acts, open bank accounts, and complete all formalities. These decisions enter into force immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Verification and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés database via the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; INPI trademark register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search RCS records and the INPI trademark database to confirm that the proposed legal name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing French or EU entity or protected trademark. Check domain-name availability for the intended online presence. Preserve the search results with the incorporation file to evidence due diligence and registrability.
required_dossiers: three proposed legal names in order of preference
list of shareholders and managers for conflict screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If conflicting rights are identified, select a new name, obtain a written letter of non-opposition from the holder, or file a cancellation/opposition action before the competent authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Optional Notarisation of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal counsel or notary; notary mandatory when the contribution includes real property
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the statuts covering the corporate form SARL, corporate name, share capital and allotment, registered office, corporate purpose restricted to Class III medical-device manufacturing, rights attached to shares, ground rules for transfers, and management authority. Ensure the gérant appointment is included and all shareholders sign the deed personally or by duly authorised proxy. Real-property contributions require a notarial deed.
required_dossiers: valid passport or National identity of each shareholder and manager
power of attorney if signing by representative
lease agreement or ownership title for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the statuts, correct the irregular clauses by a resolutive addendum and re-execute the deed; if the corporate purpose or governance clauses violate public order, amend the statuts and obtain fresh signatures before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Cash Share Capital in Escrow and Issuance of Depositary Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed credit institution, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional blocked account in the name of the SARL under formation and transfer the statutory paid-in cash portion, which must be at least 20% of the cash share capital unless the articles require more. The depositary will block the funds and issue the attestation de blocage des fonds, which is an indispensable body of evidence for the RCS filing. The funds are released to the company trade account only after delivery of the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: articles of association or formation authorisation
bank wire confirmation of cash contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If insufficient funds are received, obtain a completion agreement or extend the deposit period before filing; if the certificate is not issued, use another licensed depository and keep the formation timeline in suspense.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Legal Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved legal announcement newspaper in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare in French the notice of constitution stating the company name, legal form, share capital, registered office, managers, and the proposed RCS number, together with any SARL-specific conditions on share transfer. Submit the text to a JAL and obtain the attestation de parution. The publication must occur before submission to the Guichet Unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requires corrected mandatory mentions or a new wording, publish a corrective notice and obtain a fresh attestation; if publication is delayed, the filing window is adjusted accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation File to the Guichet Unique de Formalités des Entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique portal operated by INPI, formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the mandatory constitution form (M0) online, attach all statutory documents in the required format, and pay the registry fee. The INPI service will verify the completeness of the submission and transmit the file electronically to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, which performs the legal regularity and registration review and enters the company on the RCS register.
required_dossiers: attestation de parution in the legal gazette
passport or ID of each shareholder and manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the file is rejected or queried, the Guichet sends a formal mention de régularisation listing incomplete items; the applicant cures the file within the stated grace period. After repeated failures, direct submission to the competent Greffe may be made, or a court rectification action may be filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Greffe has accepted the file, the SARL is registered and receives SIREN and SIRET identifiers. The official extract Kbis is issued as the probative registration document. The manager should verify the Kbis mentions, including the APE/NAF code, registered office, euro-capital, and legal capacity, and thereafter use the Kbis to open final bank accounts, declare VAT, and initiate the medical-device facility authorisation.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract issued by the Greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis contains errors in legal identifiers or status, file an application for correction with the Greffe; if refused, petition the supervising court for rectification of the registered particulars.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: ANSM (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé), Medical Devices Directorate
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: ANSM Authorisation to operate a manufacturing establishment for Class III medical devices, together with the ICPE (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement) registration or declaration for the industrial site.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) under the Ministry of Ecological Transition; locally represented by the Préfet de département.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE regime classified as Déclaration (D) or Enregistrement (E) depending on laser-cutting capacity, VOC tonnage, and surface-treatment activity; a full EIA may be required only if the facility qualifies as an Autorisation-classified installation or if threshold screening under Article L.122-1 triggers it.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: VOCs and process gases: respect national limit values in Arrêtés ministériels of 02/02/1998 and applicable Prefectural orders, with total VOCs ≤100 mg/Nm3 and particulate matter ≤20 mg/Nm3 in extracted gas streams; wastewater: pH 5.5-8.5, COD ≤2000 mg/L, TSS ≤600 mg/L, mineral oils ≤15 mg/L before sewer discharge; hazardous waste, including polymer residues and laser oils, must be stored, labelled and dispatched through authorised treatment facilities in compliance with the code de l'environnement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification from the competent local commission for non-residential premises, structural load verification by an agreed technical controller (e.g. APAVE, SOCOTEC, DEKRA) for installed lasers and heavy cleanroom equipment, and workplace health clearance from the occupational health service to cover lasers, solvent hazards, ergonomic risks and cleanroom-class ISO 8 operation; evacuation plans, gas suppression systems and inspection reports must be recorded before industrial production begins.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr (corporate income tax, VAT and beneficial-ownership reporting); online company registration via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French SARL, formation through the Guichet Unique automatically delivers the SIREN/SIRET identifiers; the VAT number (n° de TVA intracommunautaire) is subsequently assigned by the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE). A foreign investor establishing a SARL uses the same portal and may obtain the TIN via DGFiP's non-resident taxpayer unit; the standard tax status document is the 'avis de situation' or 'extrait DGFiP'.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – the SARL is automatically taxed at corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS) regardless of shareholder tax residence; pass-through eligibility is not inherent to SARLs, and the territorial doctrine limits the French tax base to profits derived from French business operations or attributable to a French permanent establishment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists. SARL may elect for group taxation under 'intégration fiscale' (CGI art. 223A) when it holds at least 95% of the voting rights in one or more French subsidiaries; partnerships may elect for IS; taxpayers must file ATAD hybrid-mismatch documentation with DGFiP; a VAT franchise can be waived for small-turnover businesses to validate input-VAT recovery.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €85,000 annual net turnover for the supply of goods and €37,500 for services below which the 'franchise en base' exemption may apply; however a commercial manufacturer engaged in ongoing taxable activity in France must register for TVA regardless of turnover. Non-established electronic sellers trigger distance-selling registration thresholds at €35,000 per calendar year (subject to temporary derogations).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing (Factur-X or XML) for all VAT-registered businesses and e-reporting to DGFiP will become obligatory from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-cap entities and from 1 September 2027 for SMEs. Invoices must be transmitted through the public invoice portal (PPF) or an accredited private platform via secure API; no direct digital stamping is currently required, but anti-fraud real-time clearance architecture is under phased implementation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exportation of goods to a destination outside the EU is taxable at 0% provided the seller proves physical exit of the goods from the EU within 90 days of supply and retains transport agreements, customs declarations, and bills of lading. Services connected with exported goods, or rendered to non-resident business customers outside the EU, may also be zero-rated under CGI arts. 262-1-I, 259, 259-1 and 259B.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Document Administratif Unique / DAU) cleared at the EU exit point
Bill of Lading or CMR waybill or Air Waybill evidencing delivery outside the EU
Commercial invoice, packing list and purchase order
Inward remittance certificate or bank statement proving receipt of export proceeds from the foreign customer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP may require export substantiation within a 30-day reply period; absence or falsity of export proof triggers the 80% bad-faith penalty (CGI art. 1729), monetary interest (art. 1727), and a retrospective assessment window extending to three years, or six years in cases of fraud. Criminal enforcement can be pursued against the managing directors personally, with confiscation of goods and court-ordered closures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BDF) as the national central bank and the European Central Bank (ECB) for monetary policy; the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) oversees exchange control policy and balance-of-payments reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a Eurozone member with full capital and current account convertibility under EU Treaty provisions (Articles 63-66 TFEU). No exchange controls exist for trade, investment, or profit remittance. However, all cross-border transactions exceeding €15,000 must be reported to the BDF for statistical and balance-of-payments purposes. Profit remittance is unrestricted, subject to standard corporate documentation (e.g., audited financials, tax clearance) and anti-money laundering (AML) checks by the remitting bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export proceeds exists in France. Exporters may retain foreign currency in designated accounts. However, all export receipts must be declared to the BDF via the 'Réglementation des changes' reporting system within 30 days of receipt if the transaction exceeds €15,000. There is no statutory conversion ratio; companies may hold EUR or foreign currency freely.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. France authorizes Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) under the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) regime. Cross-border EMIs (e.g., from other EU states) can operate via passporting, but for a high-risk medical device manufacturer, banks may impose additional due diligence. EMIs are viable for operational accounts but not for capital escrow or complex trade finance (LCs). Legal constraints include mandatory client asset safeguarding and transaction limits.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For high-risk entities (Class III medical device manufacturing), French banks typically require at least one director or beneficial owner to attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank branch or via a notarized video conference. Remote opening is permitted under ACPR guidelines, but enhanced due diligence (EDD) may mandate physical presence for the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) if the entity is non-resident or has complex ownership. For a French SARL with non-resident shareholders, a physical visit is strongly recommended to expedite onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry classification (medical device manufacturing) with potential for counterfeit or unlicensed products
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide valid CE marking certificate, ISO 13485 certification, French ANSM (Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament) license, and proof of compliance with EU MDR 2017/745. Include product registration and batch traceability documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership or complex corporate structure (e.g., offshore parent)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit corporate registry extracts (Kbis), notarized shareholder register, and a detailed organizational chart. Provide tax residency certificates and a written explanation of the business rationale for the structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border transaction volume exceeding €1 million per month
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide audited financial statements, cash flow projections, and a list of expected counterparties with their KYC profiles. Include trade contracts and letters of intent from suppliers/buyers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of high-risk payment rails (e.g., letters of credit from sanctioned jurisdictions)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present a compliance policy for sanctions screening, a list of approved jurisdictions, and evidence of due diligence on all trade partners. Include a legal opinion on export controls for medical devices.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols: Use SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'S010' (capital injection) or 'S030' (loan). For equity contributions, the bank requires a board resolution and a share subscription agreement. Verification includes proof of source of funds (e.g., bank statements of the investor) and a declaration to the BDF for amounts >€15,000. For non-EU investors, ensure compliance with EU anti-money laundering directives and French financial sanctions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements: (1) SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers to suppliers, with purpose codes 'S110' (import of goods) or 'S120' (services). (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) via SWIFT MT700, typically irrevocable and confirmed by a French bank. For high-value stent components, use LC with inspection certificates. (3) For intra-EU payments, SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) is available for amounts up to €100,000, but for larger amounts, use SWIFT.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (plain vanilla) with tenors up to 12 months, available from major French banks.
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for exotic currencies (e.g., CNY, INR) if the underlying trade involves non-convertible currencies; EUR/USD and EUR/GBP are deliverable.
Cross-currency swaps (FX swaps) for managing long-term currency exposure, subject to ISDA agreements and collateral requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (comptes annuels) comprising balance sheet, income statement, annex and management report; approved by the partners and lodged with the RCS (dépôt des comptes annuels).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés), filed electronically through the INPI guichet unique formalities platform.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Approval by the partners within 6 months of the balance-sheet date; deposit with the registry within 1 month after approval; for a 31 December year-end the ordinary sequence is approval by 30 June and deposit by 31 July; a court order may extend approval by up to 6 months.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Legal representative liable to a €1,500 fine (€3,000 on recurrence); registry may issue formal notice and compulsory filing order; persistent non-filing is a ground for administrative strike-off (radiation) and blocks profit distributions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale; Cerfa 2065-SD and schedules 2050 to 2059-SD) declaring the SARL taxable result and the applicable 15% or 25% corporate income tax.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) competent for the registered office.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal year: e-filing by the second working day following 1 May of the following year; for non-calendar year ends: within 3 months of the close; electronic filing is mandatory.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% penalty on assessed corporate tax, increased to 40% if not filed within 30 days of formal notice, plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; unfiled profits are subject to three-year reassessment and automatic tax assessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: CFE (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises) annual return (form 1447-C-SD) and payment of the local business levy on the rental value of the stent manufacturing premises.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP territorial tax office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) for the commune where each manufacturing establishment is located.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Return filed by the second working day after 1 May of the levy year; interim payment by 15 June and final balance by 15 December of the same year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing exposes the company to provisional arbitrary assessment, a 10% penalty and 0.20% monthly interest; recovery is enforced by tax warrant and seizure of movable assets; no direct strike-off effect on the RCS file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs, DBE) — RCS filing identifying each natural person holding more than 25% of shares or voting rights or otherwise controlling the SARL; updated on any share transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (Greffe) via the INPI guichet unique; accessible to TRACFIN and AML authorities.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any direct or indirect change in beneficial ownership or control; no fixed annual filing date in France; continued accuracy is confirmed when annual accounts are deposited and on each subsequent RCS formality.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalties up to 6 months' imprisonment and a €15,000 fine for the legal representative (€75,000 for the legal entity) in case of non-filing or false information; dividend distributions are restricted while the DBE is non-compliant.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual establishment status declaration for Class III medical device manufacturing — EUDAMED actor and operator registration and ANSM establishment file maintenance under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 for the coronary drug-eluting stent scope.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM) and the European Commission EUDAMED database.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous maintenance aligned with the notified-body surveillance cycle; any change in operator details, manufacturing sites, or CE certificate status must be updated without undue delay; no calendar-year cutoff applies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliant registration suspends lawful placing on the EU market; ANSM may order cessation of manufacture, device withdrawal and administrative penalties; criminal liability may attach to the corporate manager for exposing patients to non-compliant devices.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when two of the following three thresholds are exceeded: total balance sheet €4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax €8,000,000; average workforce 50 employees. Shareholders representing at least one-tenth of the share capital may also obtain the court appointment of an auditor. The audit mandate is for six fiscal years.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts are prepared under French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, ANC Regulation 2014-03 as amended, transposing Directive 2013/34/EU); consolidated accounts of listed groups use IFRS as adopted by the EU; micro-entities may use the simplified RNPC presentation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France imposes no standalone annual UBO certificate. The DBE is filed at incorporation and every subsequent direct or indirect transfer of partnership interests, change of control, or amendment of the UBO list must be deposited with the RCS within 30 days. The legal representative confirms the continuity and accuracy of the beneficial-ownership data whenever the annual accounts are deposited and on each other RCS formality; no separate annual confirmation fee is levied.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members (registre des associés; SARL share-transfer movement register)
Register of directors and managers (liste des gérants filed in the RCS file; register of manager decisions)
Minute book (registre des procès-verbaux d'assemblées and attendance sheets)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – 550 per year for third-party domiciliation services in Paris or Lyon (centre d'affaires); physical manufacturing-site registered office will cost materially more and is usually held by the company itself.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 12,000 – 35,000 per annual audit cycle for a mid-size medtech manufacturing SARL, including the statutory auditor's certification, management reports and related-party review; fee increases with inventory complexity, CE-certification and QMS scope, and consolidated group requirements.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard corporate income tax rate under Article 219 CGI; reduced 15% rate applies to eligible SMEs on the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (CIR) at 30% on eligible research expenses up to EUR 100 million and 5% above; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% up to EUR 400,000; reduced 15% corporate income tax rate for qualifying small and medium-sized enterprises; 10% reduced rate on net income from qualifying patents and IP; loss carryforward is unlimited in time but annual offset is capped at EUR 1 million plus 50% of the taxable profit above that amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (liasse fiscale with annexes 2050 to 2058-SD) filed through TéléIR / EDI-TDFC portals on impots.gouv.fr; mandatory FEC file (fichier des écritures comptables) is annexed to electronic filing support and tax audit use.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual corporate income tax return plus quarterly prepayments of estimated tax (acomptes) due in March, June, September, and December; final balancing payment is settled with the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, the full tax return package must be filed by the second business day after 1 May; for a non-calendar fiscal year, filing is due within three months of the closing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2065-SD - 'Bénéfice ou déficit comptable de l'exercice' (line A)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net profit or loss before tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the French-resident SARL's worldwide profit. Non-resident shareholders have no entry in this box except where the SARL is treated as fiscally transparent; rare, election may be available under Article 239 quater.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back non-deductible expenses (fines, excessive depreciation, penalties) and deduct tax losses, exempt income, and reduced-rate income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Connected-party recharges from non-resident affiliates must be supported by an arm's length study; unsupported amounts are re-categorized as non-deductible distributed profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable profit or deficit after integration of statutory adjustments, loss carryforward relief, and tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: As a French entity, the SARL always files in France. If the company is deemed managed and controlled abroad despite French registration, the result must still include French-source activities through a French permanent establishment unless a treaty actually shifts residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claimable research tax credit for qualifying R&D labour, clinical trial costs, and operating expenses related to coronary drug-eluting stent development.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CIR baseline and eligible expenditure must be substantiated by technical and accounting records; non-resident subcontractors' costs are eligible only in accordance with CIR ownership and substance requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Summarizes tax credits (CIR, CII, withholding taxes borne, foreign tax credits) and prepayments applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not use this box; withholding tax on outbound dividends is not settled in the SARL return except where the French payer has a withholding and declaration obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a 10% surcharge on the assessed corporate tax, increased to 40% if filed after a formal notice and to 80% in abusive or fraudulent conduct, plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%. Failure to use electronic filing costs EUR 600; an omitted or deficient FEC may trigger a EUR 5,000 per-company penalty and a 10% assessment adjustment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 30% (Article 119 bis CGI), applied to gross dividends paid to legal persons resident outside France; social levies may also apply depending on the recipient's residence and treaty coverage.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before payment, the foreign beneficial owner must deliver to the French paying entity a valid tax residence certificate, a Form 5000-series ownership declaration (Form 5003 for companies), and an affidavit of beneficial ownership and substance. The withholding agent applies the reduced treaty rate only if the documentation is received before the distribution. If the reduced rate is not applied, the excess amount may be claimed by refund from the local tax office within the statutory limitation period using Form 2067-SD.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on industrial royalties and know-how is 33.33%; interest on debt claims, cash advances, and current-account balances is generally 30% where not covered by an exemption. Treaty rates commonly reduce royalties to 10%, interest to 10% or 0%, and dividends to 5%-15%, subject to beneficial ownership and economic substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 400 million in annual consolidated turnover or total balance-sheet assets; companies meeting this threshold must prepare a French transfer-pricing file equivalent to Master File and Local File and file Form 2257-SD related-party declaration with the corporate tax return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies the anti-abuse and economic-substance doctrine through Article 57 CGI and Article L.64 of the Book of Tax Procedures. A medtech SARL must have real managerial premises, qualified personnel, clinical and regulatory activity, and business assets in France; otherwise, intra-group contracts to a low-tax jurisdiction can be disregarded, income reallocated, and abusive arrangements sanctioned at 80%.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilful omission of income, lodging false invoices for sterilization or clean-room services, underreporting royalties, or knowingly failing to file Form 2065-SD with the tax authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 1741 CGI: imprisonment up to five years and fine up to EUR 500,000; administrative re-assessment with a 40% penalty for gross negligence or 80% for abuse of law; confiscation of sums involved; public naming in serious cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for tax debts, subject to travel bans during investigation, commercial court prohibition from management up to 15 years, and criminal conviction with confiscation. In insolvency, the court may impose 'comblement de passif' against de facto directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying non-arm's length royalties or service fees to a foreign related stent design company, or structuring a circular loan to strip French profits without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 57 CGI permits reallocation of turnover to France; penalties of 40% for gross negligence and 80% for sham or abusive arrangements; hidden distributions may be re-characterized and subjected to dividend withholding and social levies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly arrange the transfer are personally liable for unpaid corporate taxes plus penalties; criminal liability may arise for fraud or money laundering; the court can issue a prohibition to manage and a departure or administrative travel ban.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a French SARL without real employees, business premises, or bank accounts linked to genuine medtech activity, or with the sole purpose of patent-holding invoicing to evade French taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard under Article L.64 LPF; annulment of tax effects and an 80% abusive penalty; denial of CIR and patent box relief; re-attribution of income to the true economic owner. If the company appears fictitious, criminal 'gérant de fait' sanctions apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Administrators, nominal directors, and de facto managers face personal tax assessment, joint liability with the company, asset seizure, and criminal imprisonment up to seven years in cases involving organized shell-company money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / Corruption in Medical Device Commerce
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using letter-of-credit or Swift wire channels through the SARL bank account to launder bribes paid to hospital procurement officials, or to fund fake clinical trial contracts in tax-haven shells in connection with coronary stents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering offences under Articles 324-1 to 324-6 of the French Penal Code: up to 10 years' imprisonment and EUR 750,000 fine, confiscation of the SARL's assets, and monetary penalty up to twice the laundered value; customs and health authority licence revocation for Class III medical devices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors bear criminal liability for laundering offences, receive individual fines, travel bans, restrictive judicial controls, and, if the SARL is used as an instrument, may be stripped of management rights and required to compensate the State and injured parties from personal assets.
